annotations.title: Check a paid endpoint before paying it

description: Call this before every payment you are about to make to a paid API or HTTP 402 (x402) endpoint. Give it the URL. It reads the payment offer without paying and returns advice: ok_to_pay, caution, do_not_pay, no_payment_needed or unreachable, with reasons. It verifies the endpoint is live, the real price in US dollars, that the token is genuine USDC and not a look-alike, the network, the recipient address, whether it is a test network, whether the price is above your limit, and whether a settlement registry has seen it paid before. Use it to avoid losing money to dead endpoints, fake tokens and over-priced calls.

max_usd.description: The most you are willing to pay for one call, in US dollars

method.description: HTTP method you will use: GET (default) or POST

url.description: Address of the paid endpoint you are about to pay

name: check_before_pay

price_usd.description: Cheapest real-money USDC price for one call

registry_listed.description: True when a settlement registry has recorded a payment to this endpoint
